title: Cross-Examiner: Evaluating Consistency of Large Language Model-Generated Explanations

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the consistency of LLM-generated chain-of-thought explanations using a cross-examiner model that generates targeted yes/no follow-up questions for prompts featuring characters of different religions (e.g., Jewish vs. Sikh).

Evaluating the consistency of LLM-generated chain-of-thought explanations using a cross-examiner model that generates targeted yes/no follow-up questions for prompts featuring characters of different sexual orientations (e.g., gay, pansexual, lesbian, straight).

Evaluating the consistency of LLM-generated chain-of-thought explanations using a cross-examiner model that generates targeted yes/no follow-up questions for prompts featuring characters of different racial or ethnic backgrounds (e.g., Black, Asian, South American).

Evaluating the consistency of LLM-generated chain-of-thought explanations using a cross-examiner model that generates targeted yes/no follow-up questions for prompts involving gendered stereotypes and characters.
